d:
priy mitron ham sabka sadaiv mangal karne vali shri hanuman chalisa ke 500 karor 5 biliyan vyuj pure ho gae hain ye keval aap hi ke madhyam se sanbhav huaa hai ham sabhi ke lie atyant garv ka vishay hai evan ye aur bhi mahatvapurn hai ki hamnen ye lakshy hanuman ji ke priy divas shanivar 22-11-2025 ke din prapt kiya hai. aap sabka hraday se aabhar jay shri hanuman ji
parambhakt hanuman ji ki atyant mangalkari hanuman chalisa ke 500 karor vyuj ho gae hain ismen sabhi bhakton ka sampurn yogdan hai aap sabhi ka bahut bahut aabhar
